description: Offline Standard Engineering Map basemap for Peninsular Malaysia.

governance.note: Every asset below must carry licence, attribution, source, download_url, download_date and checksum before it may be installed. scripts/fetch_map_assets.py rejects assets that do not.

archive.name: Peninsular Malaysia vector tiles (PMTiles)
archive.source: OpenStreetMap, via a Protomaps 'basemaps' vector build
archive.redistribution: Permitted for internal serving with attribution; share-alike applies to derived databases
archive.update_procedure: Re-extract from a newer Protomaps/OSM build over the same bounds; bump version, set download_date + checksum; re-run scripts/fetch_map_assets.py --force
archive.note: Provide an internal/licensed URL and its SHA-256. No public provider is assumed.

glyphs.name: Noto Sans glyph ranges
glyphs.source: Noto Sans (Noto project) glyph PBFs, e.g. protomaps/basemaps-assets
glyphs.redistribution: Permitted under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
glyphs.modification: Permitted under OFL (Reserved Font Name conditions apply)
glyphs.attribution: Noto Sans, © the Noto project, under SIL OFL 1.1
glyphs.geographic_extent: n/a (Latin glyph ranges for English + Malay place names)
glyphs.update_procedure: Replace glyph set; set download_date + checksum; re-run fetch script
glyphs.note: Unzips to glyphs/{fontstack}/{range}.pbf for Noto Sans Regular/Medium/Italic.

sprites.name: Standard style sprite set
sprites.update_procedure: Replace sprite set; set licence, download_date + checksum; re-run fetch script
sprites.note: Record the sprite source's exact SPDX licence before hosting — the fetch script rejects it until 'licence' is set.
